set.body:
Owners: model and fit; outer storage adapters compose existing work.
Acceptance:
- Shape-aware ProfileHrfPlan represents family/drive/spec without requiring a misleading fixed materialized FmriModel design. Integrate executor dispatch without weakening existing fixed-design semantics.
- Reuse response/chunk/selection axes and existing sink contracts; flush amplitude payloads, retain only small receipts. Batch/stream/block-size/worker-count outputs agree within declared tolerance.
- Handle cancellation, sink failure, axis permutation, masks, run/censor boundaries and output precision. Artifacts retain family, units, condition/trial/voxel identity and separate uncertainty availability.
- Reuse transactional sink/catalog work bd-01KX6G9B8R86MRBZ9S8K8F5G7V; do not create a competing generic writer or publication lifecycle. An in-memory or externally supplied sink can qualify core streaming; durable catalog claims require that existing work.
- JVM+JS portable execution tests; IO adapters tested on their actual platform.
Performance: epic <=256 MiB engine goal and fixed-block memory scaling; no accumulating Vector of amplitude blocks. Count all worker buffers, reference banks and conversions; report whole-process RSS separately.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-12: Integrate shape-aware plans and bounded block output
